issue.title: Tidy up: drop the widgets command, flattenTree covers it
issue.body:
## Problem

The `widgets` command in the app and `listWidgets` in the library do what `flattenTree` plus a filter already do. Nobody I know uses them.

## Proposal

Delete `listWidgets` and the `widgets` command whenever someone has a spare hour, and point people at `flattenTree(root).filter(...)`. It is a small cleanup of about a dozen lines and the tests for it go with it. No rush.

## Acceptance

- `listWidgets` and the `widgets` command are gone.
- The remaining tests pass.
